description: A combat stim that turns fear into fuel. Frontline mercs swear by it, and at it.

effects.comeon_message: It goes in cold. Your heart starts to speed up.
effects.onset_message: Your fear is gone. You feel calm and ready for anything.

overdose.message: Your heart races until it gives out, and you don't feel it happen.

phases.end_message: It wears off, and every injury you ignored starts to hurt at once.
phases.peak_message: You feel strong and calm, and you can barely feel pain.

effects.take_line: You dose yourself with {name}, cold and clinical.

withdrawal.message: Everything aches. Coldfire fixes that. Coldfire fixes everything.

stages.easing: It fades to ordinary nerves, and ordinary nerves you can handle.
stages.onset: The fear you used to turn into energy is just fear again.
stages.peak: Everything feels dangerous and you don't know how to handle any of it. This is how most people live, without the help.
stages.rising: Your hands start shaking before your nerve goes, and you can't stop them.
stages.tail: You're scared of the right things again, about the right amount. It feels strange.

name: Coldfire
